verdicts.reason: Timing requirement stated; verified by STA, not simulation.

Structural property (edge/async reset); a scenario can check async reset behaviour but it's mainly structural. Reset behaviour is checkable by asserting reset effect, but clocking edge is not; use none.
Structural prohibition, MUST_NOT correct from 'shall contain no'; checked by lint/synthesis.
Structural constraint on combinational paths as quoted.
Glitch-freedom cannot be observed cycle-by-cycle in RTL simulation from interface signals; structural/gate-level review.
Structural SHOULD about hazard-free mux, as quoted.
Actor is the integrator, an external party, not the block; constraint is a timing-constraint task, not verifiable in simulation.
Counter width is structural; the testable behaviour is that D=255 works, which a scenario can exercise. Keep scenario check; this is acceptable as stated.
